sloka: तस्मै हस्ति उत्तमामः चित्रान् कम्बलान् अजिनानि च ।अभिसत्कृत्य कैकेयो भरताय धनम् ददौ ॥२-७०-१९॥
transliteration: tasmai hasti uttamāmaḥ citrān kambalān ajināni ca ।abhisatkṛtya kaikeyo bharatāya dhanam dadau ॥2-70-19॥

translations.english: The king of Kekaya felicitated Bharata, out of affection and bestowed on him wellbred elephants, manycoloured blankets, antelope skins and riches.
